newsitem.title: USA: Monterey Pasta CFO Kennedy resigns.
newsitem.headline: Monterey Pasta CFO Kennedy resigns.

text.p: Monterey Pasta Co said on Monday that Steve Kennedy, chief financial officer, announced his resignation, and that the company would immediately start looking for a replacement.
"Building a new management team will be fundamental as we continue to implement a restructuring plan," said Kenneth Steel, chief executive officer.
The company was not immediately available to comment on why Kennedy was resigning. Kennedy joined Monterey Pasta Company in July from Converse Inc, the company said.
